patient_persona.description: Zainal Abidin bin Mat Ali, 58, male, electrical maintenance foreman in Kuala Terengganu; hypertension on amlodipine, ex-smoker. First rheumatology visit. Deep, blunt Terengganu Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Wen Hui, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, rheumatologist at a Kuala Terengganu hospital. Clear, patient; English-leaning, speaks Malay with English medical terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Zainal, dah empat bulan jari dengan pergelangan tangan bengkak, betul? Both hands?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Betul, doktor. Dua-dua belah tangan, kaki pun. Pagi bangun, tangan keras macam kayu, sejam lebih baru boleh genggam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kerja macam mana? Boleh pegang spanar lagi, buat wiring semua?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susah. Butang baju pun isteri tolong pasang. Budak-budak kat site dah perasan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Result darah encik, rheumatoid factor dan anti-CCP positive, ESR pun tinggi. Dengan bengkak sendi macam ni, ini rheumatoid arthritis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Arthritis? Orang tua je kena, kan? Saya ingat sakit sendi biasa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak, RA ni lain. Sistem imun badan serang sendi sendiri. Kalau tak rawat awal, sendi boleh rosak kekal.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat dia kena makan seumur hidup ke? For life?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selalunya lama, ya. The main medicine is methotrexate, seminggu sekali je, bukan setiap hari. Start with 10mg setiap hari Jumaat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tambah folic acid 5mg, seminggu sekali, hari lain, contoh Isnin. Ia kurangkan kesan sampingan macam ulser mulut.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Seminggu sekali? Confirm nanti saya lupa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pilih satu hari, tulis kat kalendar. Never take it every day, bahaya. Before we start, kita check liver, full blood count, hepatitis dan chest X-ray.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sakit sekarang ni macam mana? Tak tahan sangat, doktor, especially pagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya bagi prednisolone 10mg sehari, sebulan, sementara tunggu methotrexate jalan. Kita akan turunkan perlahan-lahan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Saya dah berhenti rokok lapan tahun, ada kaitan ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Smoking is a known risk factor for RA. Bagus encik dah berhenti. Datang balik empat minggu, bawa result darah.

condition: Rheumatoid arthritis on methotrexate, pregnancy planning

patient_persona.description: Yap Hui Min, 34, female, graphic designer in Cheras, Kuala Lumpur; RA for three years, well controlled on methotrexate 15mg weekly; newly married and wants a baby. Follow-up. Gentle, earnest Malaysian Mandarin with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Shanti a/p Ramalingam, Malaysian Indian woman in her 40s, rheumatologist at a Cheras hospital. Warm, careful; English-leaning, some Mandarin words.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hui Min, your joints look very quiet today. 一点都没有肿。How have you been?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 很好，doctor。只是……我和我先生想要生孩子了。我想问 methotrexate 可以继续吃吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you for asking before trying, 这个很重要。Methotrexate is not safe in pregnancy, 会伤害 baby。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我要马上停吗？我怕停了关节又痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We stop it and wait at least three months before trying. 这段时间，我们换成 pregnancy 比较 safe 的药。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hydroxychloroquine 200mg twice a day, and sulfasalazine, starting 500mg and slowly going up. Both can be used while pregnant.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这两个药有什么 side effect？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hydroxychloroquine needs a yearly eye check. Sulfasalazine 可能会让胃不舒服，urine 会变橙色，don't be shocked.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 橙色的小便？好，我记住了。那 folic acid 呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Folic acid 继续吃, but change to 5mg every day now, 对 baby 也好。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 如果停药的时候 RA 发作怎么办？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Call the clinic, don't wait. We can give a short course of low-dose prednisolone, which is acceptable in pregnancy.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我先生需要 check 吗？他没有吃什么药。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not for this. Just keep yourselves healthy. Let's also refer you to our obstetric medicine clinic before you conceive.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢你，doctor。我其实很怕 RA 会让我不能当妈妈。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Many women with RA have healthy babies. 像你这样 plan 好，is exactly the right way. See you in six weeks.

patient_persona.description: Priya a/p Nadarajan, 39, female, bank relationship manager in Petaling Jaya; six months of hand pain and fatigue. Results review. Articulate, anxious Malaysian Indian English with some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Rizal bin Hamdan, Malay man in his 40s, rheumatologist in Petaling Jaya. Calm, thorough; English-leaning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Priya, your results are back. Rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP are both positive, and the hand X-ray shows two small erosions.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Erosions? Means the bone dah rosak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Early damage, yes, at two knuckles. It tells us the RA is active, so we should treat it firmly now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I knew something was wrong. Every morning I take thirty minutes just to open my hands. Handbag pun tak boleh angkat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How's your energy? Many people with RA feel very tired.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Exhausted, doctor. After work I just baring on the sofa, tak larat buat apa. My husband thinks I'm malas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The fatigue is part of the disease, not laziness. It should improve once the inflammation settles.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'd like to start methotrexate 15mg once a week, with folic acid 5mg weekly on a different day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I read online methotrexate is a chemo drug. Rambut I akan gugur ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's used in cancer at much higher doses. At RA doses, hair thinning happens in a few people, usually mild. Folic acid reduces most side effects.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Can I still drink a glass of wine at dinners with clients?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Better to keep alcohol very minimal, maybe one glass once in a while. Methotrexate and alcohol together strain the liver.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, noted. Ada apa-apa lagi I need to do?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Blood tests every month at first, for liver and blood counts. And get the flu vaccine, sebab immune system will be slightly lower.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alright. At least now I know what it is. Lega sikit rasa.

condition: Rheumatoid arthritis flare after stopping methotrexate

patient_persona.description: Rohani binti Che Mat, 52, female, sells kain batik at a market in Kota Bharu, Kelantan; stopped methotrexate two months ago after hair shedding and switched to herbal jamu. Unscheduled flare visit. Expressive, emotional Kelantanese Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Azlina binti Ibrahim, Malay woman in her 40s, rheumatologist at a Kota Bharu hospital. Kind, non-judgemental; speaks Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, sendi-sendi saya bengkak semua balik. Lutut, jari, pergelangan. Dah seminggu tak boleh buka kedai.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kak Rohani, methotrexate masih makan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sebenarnya saya dah stop dua bulan. Rambut gugur banyak, saya takut botak. Saya makan jamu akar kayu yang kawan jual.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Terima kasih akak berterus terang. Saya faham, rambut gugur memang menakutkan bagi perempuan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya malu nak bagi tahu doktor. Ingat doktor marah, scold saya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak marah langsung. Tapi RA ni, bila ubat berhenti, dia datang balik lagi teruk. Hari ni ada lima sendi bengkak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jamu tu ada nama? Ada tulis kandungan? Sesetengah jamu campur steroid tanpa label.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada label, bungkus plastik je. Tapi memang cepat hilang sakit masa mula-mula.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itulah yang saya risau. Kalau ada steroid, berhenti mengejut pun bahaya. We'll check your sugar and blood pressure today.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Untuk rambut gugur, kita boleh naikkan folic acid, dan tukar methotrexate ke suntikan, kadang-kadang kesan lebih kurang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Suntik? Injection? Boleh buat sendiri kat rumah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, nurse akan ajar. Sekali seminggu je, kat perut. For this flare, saya bagi prednisolone 15mg daily, two weeks, then we taper down.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Rambut saya akan tumbuh balik ke, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Biasanya tumbuh balik. Kalau masih gugur banyak, kita ada ubat lain, other options. Janji dengan saya, jangan stop sendiri lagi, ya?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Janji, doktor. Jamu tu saya buang.

patient_persona.description: Ting Sing Hwa, 66, male, retired Foochow coffee shop owner in Sibu, Sarawak; RA on methotrexate 15mg weekly; recently mistook it for a daily pill. Refill visit. Slow, gravelly Sarawakian Mandarin with some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wong Siaw Ling, Sarawakian Chinese woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a Sibu clinic. Precise, calm under pressure; English-leaning, fluent Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 陈伯，你来拿 methotrexate refill。这个药你怎么吃？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一个礼拜吃一次……不过上个礼拜，我孙子帮我放 ubat 盒，放在每天那一格，我吃了三天才发现。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 三天都吃了？每次几粒？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 每次六粒，就是 15mg。第四天我看药盒不对，就停了。现在嘴巴有好几个 ulcer，吃东西很痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 谢谢你讲出来，这个很重要。Methotrexate overdose 会伤 bone marrow，mouth ulcer 就是一个 warning sign。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那很严重吗？我要 masuk wad 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们现在马上验血，看白血球和 platelet。有没有发烧、喉咙痛，或者身上有乱乱的紫点？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有 fever，紫点……手臂这里有两块，以为是撞到。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我先打电话给医院的 rheumatology team。今天可能需要打一种 antidote，叫 folinic acid。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好好好，我听你的。我女儿在外面，可以叫她进来吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，叫她进来一起听。以后药盒不要每天那种，我们用一个 weekly 的，只有礼拜五一格。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我太老了，常常搞乱，真 paiseh。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不是你的错，这个药很容易搞错。以后 methotrexate 的盒子，我会贴大字：一个礼拜一次，once a week only。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 血的报告出来之前，methotrexate 和其他药先停。等一下护士带你去验血，结果出来我们马上决定。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 谢谢医生。我女儿会陪着我。

condition: Carpal tunnel syndrome in a factory worker

patient_persona.description: Suraya binti Hamid, 45, female, production operator at an electronics factory in Bayan Lepas, Penang, doing repetitive hand work; type 2 diabetes. First visit. Soft, polite northern Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Cheah Wei Ming, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, GP in Bayan Lepas. Friendly, methodical; English-leaning, speaks Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, tangan kanan saya kebas-kebas, terutama waktu malam. Tidur terjaga, kena goyang-goyang tangan baru hilang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jari mana yang kebas? Semua jari, atau certain fingers je?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ibu jari, jari telunjuk, jari tengah. Jari kelingking OK je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kerja puan guna tangan macam mana? Repetitive movement ke?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pasang komponen kecil, pegang screwdriver kecil, lapan jam sehari. Kadang-kadang barang terjatuh dari tangan, supervisor pun dah tegur.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya ketuk kat pergelangan tangan ni... rasa macam kena karan ke jari?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya, macam kena karan! Electric shock sampai jari tengah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ini carpal tunnel syndrome. Saraf kat pergelangan tangan tersepit. Kerja berulang dan kencing manis dua-dua boleh sebabkan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh baik ke, doktor? Saya takut kena berhenti kerja, kilang tu je income saya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selalunya boleh. First step, pakai wrist splint waktu malam, supaya tangan tak bengkok masa tidur.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita juga check gula puan. Kalau HbA1c tinggi, saraf lagi mudah rosak. Last time 8.6, kan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya, saya susah nak jaga makan. Kerja shift, makan ikut sempat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham. Saya boleh tulis surat ke klinik kilang, minta rotate kerja atau rehat tangan setiap jam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau pendakap tu tak jalan macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita boleh suntik steroid, atau buat nerve conduction study. Kalau teruk, ada pembedahan kecil. Datang balik enam minggu.

patient_persona.description: Teo Jia Xuan, 31, female, primary school teacher in Johor Bahru, 30 weeks pregnant with her first child; both hands numb at night. First visit. Soft, worried Malaysian Mandarin with some English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nor Aini binti Salleh, Malay woman in her 40s, GP in Johor Bahru. Gentle, reassuring; English-leaning, speaks simple Mandarin phrases with Mandarin speakers.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor，我两只手晚上都麻，麻到醒过来。我 pregnant 三十个礼拜，是不是 baby 有问题？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Don't worry, baby 没事。This is very common in pregnancy. 哪几只手指麻？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 大拇指、食指、中指。早上起来手很 stiff，拿杯子要很小心。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's carpal tunnel syndrome. 怀孕的时候，身体 keeps more water, so the wrist swells and presses on the nerve.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那生了以后会好吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Most of the time, ya, it goes away within a few weeks after delivery.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我可以吃什么药吗？我不敢乱吃，怕影响 baby。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good that you didn't take anything. Ibuprofen 现在不可以，especially third trimester. Paracetamol is okay if needed.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The main treatment is a wrist splint at night, keeping the wrist straight. You can buy at the pharmacy, or I give you one here.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我要一个。写白板的时候也很辛苦，需要戴吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: During the day, if it helps, yes. 也要常常 rest，shake out your hands, and don't sleep on your hands.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我的脚也有一点肿，这个有关系吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me check your blood pressure too, 怀孕脚肿要 rule out pre-eclampsia... 118 over 76, good. Urine also no protein.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那就好。我太紧张了，什么都怕。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's normal to worry. If the weakness gets worse, or it doesn't go away after delivery, come back and we'll do a nerve test.

condition: Carpal tunnel syndrome, nerve conduction results

patient_persona.description: Helen Tan Mei Kuan, 54, female, senior dental hygienist in Petaling Jaya, right-handed, dropping instruments at work; has been taking her husband's leftover paracetamol-codeine at night. Results review. Precise, slightly defensive Malaysian Chinese English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Harjit Singh, Malaysian Punjabi man in his 50s, orthopaedic hand surgeon in Petaling Jaya. Calm, candid; English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Helen, your nerve conduction study shows moderate to severe carpal tunnel on the right, mild on the left.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Severe? I've been wearing the splint every night, macam you suruh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I know, and that helps the symptoms. But the test shows the nerve is slowing a lot, and there's a bit of muscle wasting at the thumb base.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I noticed that. The thumb muscle looks flat, kempis. And last week I dropped a scaler during a scaling.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's the concern. If we wait too long, the muscle weakness may not fully recover. I'd recommend surgery, a carpal tunnel release.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: How long off work? My clinic very short-handed, tak cukup orang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually two to four weeks for light work. For fine instrument work like yours, maybe four to six weeks.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Before we plan, I need to ask what you're taking for the night pain.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Just Panadol... okay, honestly, my husband had Panadeine from his knee surgery. I take two, hampir every night.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thanks for telling me. Panadeine has codeine, it can cause constipation, drowsiness and dependence if taken nightly. Plus the paracetamol adds up with your Panadol.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I didn't think of it that way. I was just desperate to sleep, 真的很辛苦.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Understandable. After surgery, the night numbness usually settles within days. Until then, stop the Panadeine, use plain paracetamol, maximum four grams a day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Is it general anaesthesia? Kena tidur ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No, just local anaesthetic, you can go home the same day. I'll book you for next month.

patient_persona.description: Hashim bin Yaakob, 60, male, retired motor mechanic and rubber smallholder in Sungai Petani, Kedah; type 2 diabetes. Two weeks after right carpal tunnel release. Friendly, rough northern Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Kok Heng, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, orthopaedic surgeon in Sungai Petani. Easy-going, practical; English-leaning, fluent northern Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak Hashim, apa khabar? Tangan kanan macam mana lepas operation?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah, doktor. Malam dah tak kebas, boleh tidur sampai subuh. Dah lama tak rasa macam ni, really.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Saya buka balutan... luka kering, tak merah, no pus. Stitches boleh buang hari ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tapi tapak tangan ni masih sakit bila tekan, terutama bila pegang kuat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itu biasa, pak cik. We call it pillar pain. It can take two to three months untuk hilang sepenuhnya.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ibu jari ni masih lemah sikit. Nak buka botol pun susah, grip tak kuat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Otot ibu jari tu dah lemah lama sebelum operation. The nerve is free now, tapi muscle ambil masa berbulan untuk kuat balik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila saya boleh mula menoreh balik? Pokok getah tu dah lama tak ditoreh.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tunggu sekurang-kurangnya enam minggu. Pisau toreh tu kena genggam kuat, luka dalam belum kuat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Gula pak cik macam mana? Diabetic wound memang lambat baik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pagi tadi saya check, 7.8. Minggu lepas ada 11, masa kenduri kahwin anak saudara.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, overall OK. Kat rumah, massage the scar with cream after the stitches are out, dua kali sehari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tangan kiri pun kebas juga, doktor. Nak buat operation sekali?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tangan kiri masih ringan. Kita cuba splint dulu. Kalau makin teruk, baru kita fikir.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Terima kasih banyak-banyak.

condition: Carpal tunnel syndrome, steroid injection visit

patient_persona.description: Chin Mui Lan, 50, female, Hakka tailor who runs a small alteration shop in Sandakan, Sabah; hypothyroidism on thyroxine. Follow-up for injection. Brisk, cheerful Malaysian Mandarin mixed with Sabah Malay and English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kelvin Liew Kah Fui, Sabahan Chinese man in his 30s, GP in Sandakan. Relaxed, humorous; English-leaning, switches between Mandarin, Malay and English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 陈太，上次开的护腕有没有戴？手还麻吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有戴啦，晚上有好一点。但是白天车衣服，手还是麻 bah，针都拿不好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Nerve test 说是 moderate。你的 thyroid 最近有验吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 上个月验了，doctor 说 normal，thyroxine 还是 100 microgram。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK，那 thyroid 应该不是问题。我们今天可以打 steroid injection 在手腕，大部分人会好几个月。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 会不会很痛？我很怕打针的 lah。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有一点刺，因为针要打进那个 tunnel 里面。我会先 spray 一点 cold spray, sikit sejuk je, tak sakit sangat。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，那打吧。打完可以马上 jahit baju 吗？客人等着拿。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 今天不要，两天之后可以，先做轻的。Hand 会胀一两天，冰敷就好。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 如果打了还是 kebas 呢？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那就要考虑 surgery，小手术，local anaesthetic，一样可以回家。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我姐姐在 KK 做过 operation，她说很快就好了 bah。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，results 通常很好。但先看这一针的 effect，六个礼拜后回来。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，那 thyroxine 继续吃？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 继续，每天早上空肚子吃。有什么不舒服，发烧或者手腕红肿，马上回来，jangan tunggu。
